name: credential-modernization-unseal-valid
purpose: Happy path for §11.6 mode "u": legacy-compat wrap of a JWS unseal token, decodes to the same JWS payload bytes the §9 verifier accepts.

expected.legacy_compat_note: A conformant stack MUST be able to losslessly serialize the CBOR payload back to the JWS Compact wire form documented in §9. The token sig (HMAC over base64url(header)+"."+base64url(payload)) is the EXACT byte sequence a §9 verifier would compute.
